</title>

<traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 74

---

You've learned to swing your lash ever faster and in wider arcs. The damage die of your lash increases to 1d6 instead of 1d4 and it gains the [sweep](/Traits.aspx?ID=708) trait.
